|translation='''Title:''' Rebel Scout.

'''Card text:'''
You may move as a react without spending Force to an adjacent location where you have a Rebel with ability greater than 2 or a leader.

'''Lore:'''
Vildar Blin is a typical Rebel scout, and front-line reconnaissance is his assignment. Trained in first-response tactics, many gained special-forces experience before joining the Rebellion.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese does not say the react is to a battle.
